name: Esmeralda
personality: Wild, physically strong fisher girl who loves fishing and food.
story: A fisherman's daughter (father Sinza) from the coastal village of Fina in Dagda, she carries a Bloodmark that Dagda's gods do not recognise. She joins automatically on Dietrich's route; on Cai, Theodora and Leda routes she must be recruited after her Cape Damasen quest.

personalSkill.name: Brawn
personalSkill.effect: Equipment weight reduced to 80%. Lv20: Throwing Arm (Hit+10, Atk+2 when throwing spears); Lv35: Throwing Arm+ (Hit+20, Atk+4).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics S; KeenGamer A (durable frontliner).

why: Joins Dietrich's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.notes: Soldier in Ch 5, Armored Knight in Ch 6 (Heavy E+, Axe C, Spear C). Dreadnought in Ch 10 at Renown 8, Lv 35 (Heavy D, Axe B, Spear B). Throw spears for Throwing Arm+ (Hit +20, Atk +4 at Lv 35); Grasitha is hers. Master Great Counter, then Focused Counter. Res is very low: keep her away from mages and next to a Bishop.

guide.summary: Thrown-spear armored tank. Brawn cuts her gear weight to 80% and Throwing Arm boosts thrown spears, so she fights at range 1 to 2 with Grasitha and holds lines. Her Res is poor: give her a Hexlock Shield and a Bishop neighbor.

guide.role: Armored Hammer breaker and spear thrower
guide.summary: The army's armor breaker and second wall from Ch 9: she takes Dadao's [[item:Hammer]], and Brawn makes it Wt 16. Walk her into the armored lane, Hammer the knights on player phase, then let the enemy phase come to her: thrown spears counter at range 2 with [[ability:Throwing Arm]]. Mages are her one threat, so they die first.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: Hammer the armor, Spike if the forecast is under 80. Enemy phase: hold a choke with the [[item:Short Spear]] equipped so she counters at 1 and 2. Keep her inside Leda's ring on mage turns.
